Albert Einstein’s theory of relativity fundamentally changed how we understand the universe by linking space, time, and gravity. It consists of two parts: special relativity, which is used in particle physics and cosmology, and general relativity, which explains gravity. In simple terms, general relativity shows that massive objects like planets and stars warp the fabric of space and time around them. This warping is what we experience as gravity.

The first three months of the year are January, February, and March.
